{{Top|leg}}
A '''locator''' was a type of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], one who specialized in finding people who attempted to remain hidden. Usually working for [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] and corporate executives, locators were hired to find targets such as runaway children, [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]] who swindled their client, or [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]] who owed a debt. Unlike regular bounty hunters, locators preferred to use investigation, computer proficiency and a network of contacts to locate their targets. Outsmarting their target was their chosen method of acquiring their quarry rather than using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Locators were consummate professionals who honored their contracts. Locators were fully accredited bounty hunters, carrying an [[Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate/Legends|Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate]].<ref name="PGT">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
